# Hydrofarm 0.1.1

A performance and code-quality release — no gameplay or content changes.

## Changed

- Pipe, pump, and energy-cable networks now stagger their cached network
  re-scans by block position instead of all re-walking on the same tick after a
  nearby connection changes. This removes a periodic server-tick spike on large
  or frequently-edited logistics networks; small setups are unaffected.
- Internal cleanup: consolidated duplicated logic (position-based work
  staggering, adaptive transfer back-off, and captured-animal NBT handling) into
  shared helpers. No behavior change.
